none: PAS CAM-411375: Roman Coin : PAX PVBLICA - Pax standing with branch and sceptre.
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Helena, dating to AD 337-41 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads PA[X PVBLICA]. Reverse shows Pax standing with branch and sceptre. Mint is Trier, - // TR(P) crescent. This mintmark is interesting as it is for a post-April 340 issue in which coins of Helena did not figure. Is it possible that a small number of coins for Helena were struck, or is this a contemporary…
